glosses: to start spinning, to start twisting (to cause something to begin to rotate)
to curl (to twist or form (e.g. hair, etc.) into ringlets or waves)
to spin, to twist (to tightly wrap something around something else)
to wind, to bend (to change directions)
to shut off by twisting (closing off a pipe etc. to cut the flow of a gas, liquid, or heat)
to screw on (to close or cover something, e.g. a jar or bottle, tightly)
to ring up, to dial up (to contact by telephone)
to spin (to make rotations about one's own axis)
to pace (to walk back and forth in a small distance)
to hang around (to endear someone by being near them)
to rush (to act quickly in order to take care of something)

examples.text: Tamten to się umie zakręcić, kupił ledwo rok temu wielkie mieszkanie, a teraz taką furę!
Powinieneś zakręcić się dookoła tej pracy, doskonale byś się tam sprawdził.
Marek zakręcił się wokół niej tak skutecznie, że teraz mają trójkę dzieci.
